name: Anthony of Padua
contribution: A Portuguese Catholic priest and member of the Order of Friars Minor.

checks.lead: Anthony of Padua or Anthony of Lisbon (born Fernando Martins de Bulhões; 15 August 1195 – 13 June 1231) was a Portuguese Catholic priest and member of the Order of Friars Minor.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
